about: The cheap judge's self-test (#609; README.md here). The game's own renders, ranked from Sean's words and picks, confirmed by him (#612). now, broken, ambient_x2 and fog_off: the street at golden hour (shot_match_street) in one run of main on 2026-11-03 (screenshots.gd --only=shot_match_street --variants=ambient_x2.json,fog_off.json,broken_look.json), so their numbers compare. noon_before: the store front at noon before the light pass, the 'today' panel of docs/screenshots/light_pass/2026-10-23/2_noon_front.jpg (its label covered), the look Sean called 'too cheap, too indie' ('the day time outside looks the worst', 2026-10-23, #318); noon_now: store_front_noon on main 2026-11-03, put through the same 480x270 JPEG so resolution isn't the difference. early: round 0 (2026-10-01_r1). A first set (2026-11-03_cheap_p) used the 2026-10-22 street at golden hour as the 'too cheap' one; #318 says golden hour 'holds up better', so it didn't carry his words and was dropped.
by: Sean, 2026-11-04 (#612): 'I agree with the judge' (the ranking, and broken about the same as now to his eye)
